scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm -r --sort test && go -C vcs test ./...
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r --sort typecheck && go -C vcs vet ./...
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm build && PORTABLEFS_TEST_POSTGRES=true pnpm --filter @portablefs/metadata-db exec vitest run src/postgres.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:s3-bucket: pnpm build && PORTABLEFS_TEST_S3_BUCKET=true pnpm --filter @portablefs/storage-s3 exec vitest run src/s3.integration.test.ts
